remarks: Nestled on one of New Canaan's most prestigious streets, discover the epitome of classic charm reimagined in this stunning post-and-beam barn residence originally built in 1906. Welcome to a unique home exuding warmth and character at every turn. Situated on nearly 3 acres of picturesque park-like grounds, this residence provides a private, tranquil retreat from the hustle and bustle of daily life. As you enter, you're greeted by an abundance of natural light that fills the spacious rooms, creating an inviting ambiance throughout. Step into the heart of the home, where the soaring 19-foot ceiling of the great room and loft, serves as a breathtaking focal point. Here, the timeless charm of post-beam architecture seamlessly blends with modern updates, resulting in a space that is both cozy and elegant. The allure continues with sunny bedrooms providing comfort and serenity. Fresh, white interiors accentuate the home's airy atmosphere, while a splendid custom wood roof adorned with solid copper gutters and trim adds to its architectural appeal. Conveniently located just 1.5 miles from town, this residence is the perfect combination of privacy and accessibility.
